auth.note: Run `npm run auth` once. It opens a headed browser, you log in by hand, and it saves .auth/state.json. Never commit that file.

scenes.narration: Replace this line with the problem your product solves. Fifteen to thirty words, written for the ear.
Say why this screen matters, not what is visibly happening on it. Lead with the problem, never the feature name.
Close on what changed for the viewer. One sentence, then stop talking.
